## [3.73.0] - 2026-09-06

### Features

- persist catalog order presets

### Bug Fixes

- import ProductSortMode in catalog order dialog
- select catalog preset inline
- defer catalog preset enter submission
- await catalog before inline reorder
- scope catalog ownership by account
- retain hidden product order slots
- clear catalog state across accounts
- await catalog state before dialog snapshot
- recover from catalog discard failure
- restore product sort on reorder discard
- complete category grid and legacy ownership
- align complete category reorder baseline
- align complete custom reorder scope
- support catalog reorder in list view
- discard unsaved catalog dialog edits
- persist stable variant group order
- bind queued catalog writes to POS
- snapshot catalog only when reordering
- harden catalog reorder persistence
- snapshot each catalog reorder session
- preserve all-products reorder scope
- include descendants in catalog dialog
- finalize catalog preset before layout save
- resync restored catalog on discard
- apply remote catalog atomically
- retain descendant product reorder
- synchronize catalog order safely
- preserve catalog reorder state
